queries:
WITH overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
),
status_avg AS (
  SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rfistat
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT s.rfistat, s.avg_modindex, o.overall_avg
  FROM status_avg s, overall o
  WHERE s.avg_modindex > o.overall_avg
)
SELECT
  rfistat,
  avg_modindex,
  avg_modindex - overall_avg AS diff_from_overall,
  avg_modindex - (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) FROM qualifying) AS diff_from_qualifying_mean
FROM qualifying;
WITH g AS (
  SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rfistat
),
o AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_mod) AS overall_avg FROM g
),
q AS (
  SELECT g.rfistat, g.avg_mod, g.avg_mod - o.overall_avg AS above_avg
  FROM g, o
  WHERE g.avg_mod > o.overall_avg
)
SELECT rfistat,
       avg_mod AS avg_modindex,
       above_avg AS diff_from_overall_avg,
       avg_mod - (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) FROM q) AS diff_from_qualifying_mean
FROM q;
WITH overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg

),
status_avg AS (

  GROUP BY rfistat
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT s.rfistat, s.avg_modindex, o.overall_avg

  WHERE s.avg_modindex > o.overall_avg
)
SELECT
  rfistat,
  avg_modindex,
  avg_modindex - overall_avg AS diff_from_overall_avg,
  avg_modindex - (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) FROM qualifying) AS diff_from_qualifying_mean
FROM qualifying;
WITH overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
),
status_avg AS (
  SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rfistat
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT s.rfistat,
         s.avg_modindex,
         s.avg_modindex / o.overall_avg AS ratio_to_overall
  FROM status_avg s
  CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE s.avg_modindex > o.overall_avg
)
SELECT rfistat,
       avg_modindex,
       ratio_to_overall,
       avg_modindex - (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) FROM qualifying) AS diff_from_qualifying_mean
FROM qualifying;
